procedural_matters: UKR 222721 was represented by Oscar Madonich.
The technical committee was represented by Melissa Goldstraß (member of the technical committee).
Charlotte May (member of the technical committee) attended the hearing as an observer.
facts: After finishing race 5, UKR 222721 began to detach some ropes on her boat.
One minute after UKR 222721 finished race 5, the technical committee approached her to make a random measurement check.
When the technical committee UKR 222721, the tie line which shall be tied to the centreboard elastic was not tied to the centerboard.
The technical commitee applied a standard penalty as per SI Addendum Standard Penalties for not complying with class rule 14(f).
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the technical committee] Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 62.1(a) are not met.
